timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,380–1,390 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak, with the exchange rate hovering around 1,380–1,390 KRW per dollar—meaning you need more won to get your $2,000. News reports indicate the rate has touched 1,390 and is threatening 1,400, driven by US rate hikes and high oil prices. Analysts note the won is consolidating at elevated levels this week, with no clear downward pressure expected.

TIP: Consider waiting for signs of won strength (lower KRW/USD rates) before converting, or dollar-cost average smaller amounts if the rate stabilizes below 1,380 in coming weeks.
